content.json:
## Meridian platform overview
Requests, failures and latency per service (cloud_RoleName), plus worker queue lag.

content.query:
requests
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(success == false), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by cloud_RoleName
| extend failedPercent = round(100.0 * failed / total, 2)
| order by total desc
content.title: Requests by service

content.query:
requests
| summarize failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: Failed requests over time

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "meridian.queue.approximate_length"
| summarize avg(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m), tostring(customDimensions.queue)
| render timechart
content.title: Queue depth (worker-jobs metric)
